prose.text: These are the gates /implement runs, in fence order. - **Rust delta:** C1 and C3 are real Rust delta, so every Rust gate runs, with no `defer`. - **Both runners** are the nextest entry and the `cargo test --workspace` entry. Doctests are their own leg. - **UI gate:** this is a UI-touching chunk, so its headful self-verify is the strict routine `--e2e` arm. - **Live leg:** preceded by the non-priming liveness probe (the sidecar on `PATH`, pulse-app's OTLP port   answering), never `boot`. - **CI:** the chunk changes code the `rust` and `a11y` jobs re-run, so the operator pass commits, pushes behind a   clean-tree guard, and reads CI. prose.text: These are the gates /implement runs, in fence order. - **Rust delta:** C1 and C3 are real Rust delta, so every Rust gate runs, with no `defer`. - **Both runners** are the nextest entry and the `cargo test --workspace` entry. Doctests are their own leg. - **UI gate:** this is a UI-touching chunk, so its headful self-verify is the strict routine `--e2e` arm. - **Live leg:** preceded by the non-priming liveness probe (the sidecar on `PATH`, pulse-app's OTLP port   answering), never `boot`. - **CI:** the chunk changes code the `rust` and `a11y` jobs re-run, so the operator pass commits, pushes behind a   clean-tree guard, and reads CI. CI#36774237196 (the base) measured a 785 s wall, and the wait is sized from it. - **Smoke:** the CLI entrypoint (`main.rs`) and its scenario resolution (`paths.rs`) change, so the smoke is the   real binary on the changed path: `conductor run P-017`. It refuses before any load, so it writes nothing and needs   no Pulse, which is why it is not the mint-then-read `status` form. The live suite then drives the full boot path.
